title: Crossroads of Continents: Automated Artifact Extraction for Cultural Adaptation with Large Multimodal Models
reasoning: The paper primarily evaluates cultural awareness and adaptation in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) based on geography and artifacts. While it discusses stereotypes (bias) and includes some artifacts with religious origins (e.g., 'Islamic art', 'Buddhist elements'), it does not benchmark or focus on religion, faith, morals, or ethics as its core objective.
